title: VDAC1 (2JK4) Structure Atlas
description: Standalone private Structure Atlas for human VDAC1 (PDB 2JK4, complete 11,000-model 11-method AIS conformational cohort). Maintained independently of the Jernigan and Domenico project registries.

staged_targets.notes: Complete 11,000-model cohort across 11 AIS sampling methods (1,000 models per method) with full 16-timepoint ProteinEBM Model 6 energies.
